args.name: soil-worksite-assessment
args.function: Physically examine a reachable proposed planting patch and report evidence about its substrate, worksite clearance, and suitability for the personally mastered root-planting-trial. Distinguish observed causes from unresolved uncertainty.
args.conditions: The placement at 9.25,12.9 was rejected because hand preparation requires ordinary soil, although my current local regime is reported as ordinary soil and the visible terrain is f. A previous nearby placement was rejected for overlap. No unfinished operation or reserved material is reported. Assessment must examine the proposed patch rather than assume my current location describes it.
args.inputs: A reachable proposed x/y patch; no tools are currently owned. Do not consume a root or start planting merely to assess it.
args.costs: Method and appropriate time or energy costs are unknown. Use a bounded physical examination; report if equipment is required.
args.effects: Provide personal, evidence-based findings about the examined patch and any unresolved planting constraints. Do not alter terrain, grant mastery, or claim successful planting.

candidates.function: Prepare a small soil patch and place one real root unit for a persistent observation trial; resume or cancel unfinished work.
candidates.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit; two work rounds at one energy each. Supply inputStackId and an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y patch within 0.65 plus body radius. Resume/cancel use personal processId (omitting it selects the sole unfinished job). No tools or water are granted.
candidates.effects: Preparation and exact escrow persist when other actions interrupt work. Resume pays only remaining work. Cancel releases surviving unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort and spoiled material are never refunded. Completed plots retain the real reserved root while existing environmental ageing runs. Reinspect with baseline probe: 30 elapsed rounds mark an inconclusive observation interval, not maturity or inferred death. There is no propagation, tending or harvest rule in this precursor, and no reward for placing it. Genuine observed changes can use existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback. Other people can observe the actual plot; execution requires personal study.

candidates.function: Record a planted-root baseline, observe, or physically uncover and cover an existing specimen while retaining actual progress and private evidence.
candidates.costs: Begin/observe: one round and 0.2 energy. Inspect: two paid work rounds, one energy each, no consumed root or tools. Only the creator may handle a plot; anyone may observe reachable public state. Provide target plot ID; resume/cancel can use exact personal processId.
candidates.effects: Begin records an external baseline and claims a personal work lock. Inspect uncovers the existing reserved root, records actual present condition, then replaces displaced soil. Interruption retains exposure and paid work; resume completes outstanding work only. Cancel/death releases the lock without automatically covering or refunding effort. Existing specimen ageing continues while unattended. Repeated unchanged observations and the 30-round checkpoint create no reward. No inferred germination, tending benefit, harvested food or biomass is supplied. Relevant dated physical changes may use the single existing grounded-understanding rule. Records remain personal until actual communication.

candidates.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"lin\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop a minimal coordinate-specific, non-destructive worksite examination. Related capabilities were searched: probe supports nearby visible-subject observation or owned-sample tests, root-assessment requires an existing planted specimen, and root-planting-trial performs paid placement. None establishes an executable examination of an unplanted x/y footprint against the planting operation's substrate and clearance requirements. Reuse their applicable code rather than reinventing observation or planting checks. The reported local regime and terrain symbol do not establish conditions at the proposed patch; neither earlier rejection establishes its current cause.\",\"specification\":\"Current-conversation development handoff: implement soil-worksite-assessment with finite x/y inputs and one non-destructive examine mode. First support the actual footprint used by root-planting-trial@1; do not add arbitrary excavation, planting, sampling, or a site-search service. Dependencies and recorded code reuse: foundation-open@1 open.probe for grounded observation and evidence recording; root-planting-trial@1 long.root-planting for the exact footprint, ordinary-soil eligibility, interaction range of 0.65 plus body radius, and placement-clearance calculations. Extract a shared read-only evaluator if necessary; do not call a mutating planting handler or duplicate divergent rules. No prerequisite tools, root, or existing plot are required for accessible surface examination. Lin must independently study this ability and physically reach the nominated patch, using navigate separately at its existing costs if needed. Require a living actor, sufficient energy, valid in-bounds coordinates, and actual safe sensory/manual access. Examination costs one completed simulation round and 0.5 energy, charged once for the started physical attempt; no material is consumed or reserved. Do not deduct energy for an invalid invocation that never starts work. Light contact may establish accessible surface texture, but this precursor must not displace soil, clear objects, disturb organisms, expose buried material, or infer deeper composition. If those actions or equipment would be needed, report the specific unresolved constraint instead. Output a private, dated evidence record with exact x/y, examined footprint, actor, observation event IDs, method, observed surface findings, observable clearance evidence, and the applicable root-planting-trial@1 reference. Distinguish observed facts, rule-based interpretation, and unknowns. Only affirm or deny ordinary-soil suitability when physical evidence supports that interpretation; a terrain glyph alone is insufficient. Reuse authoritative spatial checks internally, but never disclose concealed occupants, resources, object IDs, or inaccessible substrate data. Unsupported causes remain unknown, not invented diagnoses. A fully observed overlap can be reported with exact visible object references; otherwise report only what examination established. Mark planting compatibility as provisional, time-stamped, and incomplete where necessary. Root availability and freshness remain separate planting prerequisites; assessment neither reserves the patch nor guarantees future placement. No root is taken from item-3-lin-12, no planting job starts, and no terrain, stock, ownership, mastery, nutrition, or protected account changes. At start retain an attempt ID, target footprint, paid cost and started state. Completion after the round records only performed observations. Interruption, explicit cancellation, or death ends this one-round attempt; it cannot resume as a completed inspection, gives no completion record, and refunds neither spent time nor energy. Preserve any already emitted actual observations as partial evidence only. A later attempt pays anew. There is no escrow, ongoing maintenance, automatic revisit, or persistent physical worksite; ordinary environmental and inventory ageing continue during executed simulation time. Review and implementation waiting advance no world time. Records can become stale and must not be silently updated. Other people receive findings only through actual communication and must independently examine or act for themselves. Encode validation, costs, completion, evidence filtering and cancellation in the handler rather than recurring model adjudication.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"Functional information is the product; requesting, registration, studying, naming, and successful handler completion alone earn no pleasure or satisfaction. This precursor adds no new experience award or comfort effect. If the already implemented grounded-understanding rule accepts a genuinely verified, personally applicable observation or informative failure, use that single rule unchanged, including its existing bounded amount, cap, cooldown, decay and cross-ability evidence deduplication. Do not create a second award for the same fact through probe or root-assessment. Unresolved speculation and repeated unchanged checks do not become information-gain rewards. No protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions are altered, and basic nutrition is unchanged.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit observable examination-start, examination-completed, interrupted, cancelled or failed events only when those transitions actually occur. Supply reusable metadata: attempt ID, actor ID, exact patch coordinates and footprint, phase, elapsed work, linked evidence IDs, and observed/unknown constraint statuses. Reuse a neutral inspection indicator and optional transient footprint outline; no terrain transformation or planted-root asset is created. Partial, inaccessible and failed checks must remain visibly distinct from completion. A completed examination may still show unknown or unsuitable findings and must never display successful planting, guaranteed suitability, hidden objects, or granted mastery.\"}]}"}
